shared_elements: quadruped animals shown in profile facing one direction
repeated figures aligned in a row / register-like horizontal organisation
weathered stone surface as ground for the carving
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on stone in which animals appear in strict profile and elements are lined up in horizontal rows, which gives a loose register-like correspondence. But A is a smooth, finely modelled frieze with naturalistic, textured rams led by detailed human figures on a flat wall slab, while B is a coarse, schematic, silhouette-like carving of assorted creatures and geometric bands wrapped around a rough free-standing pillar, with no human procession at all.
